educationalGoal: In modern society, it is necessary to consider the essential relationships between science, technology, and social values by coordinating values (risk communication) and creating new values (innovation) among various stakeholders. This course focuses on the relationships between development of scientific knowledge and technology, the thoughts and behaviors of people, and history of relationships between social systems.
advice: Class summary: 1. Understand the problems of analyzing society with the theme of electricity. 2. Explain the historical development of electrical theory and technology. 3. Analyze various aspects of dependence on electrical technology in daily life, culture, and communication. 4. Analyze various aspects of the relationship between electrical technology and politics and economy. 5. Explain analytical methods to consider the above topics, hold group discussions, and write a research paper. Learning advice: A. For the topics of each lecture, pay attention to how your thoughts and behaviors are influenced by electrical technology in your daily life, and consider the social values of people in the past who had no such knowledge and technology. B. Try to identify and understand local issues and history from the perspective of electrical technology. C. Each assignment is prepared to help you write a research paper, in addition to preparing and reviewing each lecture. D. It takes substantial time to write a research paper. Prepare according to the lecture schedule. E. Research papers are also aimed at mastering university-level writing skills. Pay attention to the format.
requiredKnowledge: High school-level knowledge of electromagnetism is not required, but you should review knowledge from junior high school. Consult encyclopedias, dictionaries, reference books, and the Internet for unknown technical terms and personal names. Review the precautions learned in the basics of study when writing a research paper.

activityGoals.body: Be able to analyze social and cultural dependence on electrical technology in your daily life.
Be able to analyze electrical innovations from political, economic, and cultural perspectives.
Be able to discuss your own opinions logically and empirically based on historical research.
Be able to write a research paper in an academic format.
Be able to self-evaluate the relationship between this course and the college’s educational goals.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Analyze social and cultural dependence on electrical technology in daily life based critically on previous studies and local issues. (2) Analyze electrical science and technology innovations critically from multiple social perspectives. (3) Insist on your own opinions logically and empirically according to the opinions of previous studies and group discussions, and summarize the entire group discussion logically. (4) Write a research paper that provides useful opinions for society in an academic format. (5) Self-evaluate your career choices.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain social and cultural dependence on electrical technology in daily life in your own words. (2) Analyze electrical science and technology innovations from multiple social perspectives. (3) Insist on your own opinions based on previous studies and group discussions, and contribute logically to the entire group discussion. (4) Write a research paper in an academic format. (5) Perform a self-evaluation.
